other_likely_causes: low fuel pressure or restricted fuel delivery
upstream exhaust leak near the oxygen sensor
recommended_first_check: Perform a smoke test of the intake tract, vacuum hoses, PCV system, and intake-manifold gasket for leaks.
reasoning: P0171 means the PCM has reached a sustained positive fuel-trim correction because Bank 1 is reporting excess oxygen. An unmetered-air leak is a common cause, particularly if lean trims are greatest at idle; if no leak is found, verify MAF readings and fuel pressure/delivery before condemning the oxygen sensor.
